summary.en: Al-Shabaab fighters captured a village near Mataban in central Somalia and seized Coomaad in Hirshabelle, prompting protests against the regional election. In Minnesota, Somali-American Uber driver Mohamed Yusuf was brutally assaulted, left in critical condition after a passenger beat him, stole his car and ran him over. A Somali refugee woman was killed by Houthi shelling of a camp in Lahj, and militia forces killed eight Somali civilians near the Kenya-Ethiopia border. Heavy rainstorms in Lower Shabelle killed a mother and two children. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al-Shabaab-krigere erobret en landsby nær Mataban i sentrale Somalia og tok kontroll over Coomaad i Hirshabelle, noe som førte til protester mot det regionale valget. I Minnesota ble den somaliske amerikanske Uber-sjåføren Mohamed Yusuf brutalt angrepet, ble lagt i kritisk tilstand etter at en passasjer slo ham, stjal bilen hans og kjørte over ham. En somalisk flyktningkvinne ble drept av houthiene som skjøt på en leir i Lahj, og militsstyrker drepte åtte somaliske sivile nær grensen mot Kenya-Etiopia. Kraftige regnstormer i Lower Shabelle drepte en mor og to barn. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
